newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsican fishermen end blockade of island ports.
newsitem.headline: Corsican fishermen end blockade of island ports.

text.p: Hundreds of fishermen called off an eight-day blockade of Corsican ports after winning a pledge of fresh state aid, Corsican officials said on Tuesday.
"The state has promised to provide the fishing industry with economic aid over a five-year period," said Paul Patriarche, vice-president of the Corsican Assembly.
The decision to call off the protest followed 48 hours of negotiations with representatives of the French central government.
The fishermen had accused the government of failing to include them in a plan to provide businesses on the Mediterranean resort island with a package of tax breaks to spur economic development.
The government has proposed transforming Corsica into a tax haven to help it overcome economic damage caused by a decades-long campaign of low-level separatist violence.
